scope.research_boundary: Use one Luna evidence-only researcher; root remains sole writer. Before opening any result page, inspect every linked source, attempt and campaign history, plus all source_url values for the target/candidate/platform; exact-literal search the proposed final URL across repository data and docs. If present or the pre-open audit cannot be proven, skip without reopening. Per model: at most one distinct exact-model web query and one genuinely new product/seller page open.
price_rules: Only add a current observed CNY transaction/listing price when the evidence identifies the exact retained model and build/package and shows a dated public mainland seller or manufacturer offer. Preserve seller and price basis; distinguish checkout price, MSRP, quote, owner report, search card and promotion.

A USD global-store reference, old official list price, search snippet, generic model-family offer, unresolved custom build, unselected option, price range, or inaccessible page is not a current observed mainland transaction price.

Do not infer frame/complete-bike package, generation, selected SKU, seller authorization, stock, mainland delivery, tax, warranty, returns or final checkout. Keep unresolved or conflicting facts explicit.

Use one distinct query per exact target. Reuse existing sources without reopening; do not retry an inaccessible page or URL. No login, quote submission, seller contact, cart, purchase or hidden checkout probing.
excluded: No agent edits; no XHS, Weibo, personal browser, login/CAPTCHA, external message, seller outreach, quote/cart/purchase, image download/rehosting, or delivery action.
No updates outside the ten frozen price fields, supporting source records, research attempt records and dated batch documentation.
